time_var.var_name: overall survival period from diagnosis date (year)

notes: Provenance: variable appears in GEO sample metadata for GSE162682 (e.g., GSM4956773, GSM4956774, etc.).
Time origin and unit are explicit in the variable name ('from diagnosis date' and '(year)').

Event variable values observed in metadata are '0', '1', and 'NA'. The metadata/paper do not explicitly define coding; typical convention is 1=death, 0=alive/censored, but this is not stated and therefore var_meaning is set to 'unknown'.
Some samples contain 'NA' indicating missing data for event and/or time.

time_var.var_name: overall survival period from resection date (year)

notes: Provenance: variable appears in GEO sample metadata for GSE162682; the paper explicitly refers to analyses using 'time from tumor resection' (e.g., univariable Cox regression of time from tumor resection).
Time origin and unit are explicit in the variable name ('from resection date' and '(year)').
Event coding is not explicitly defined in the provided metadata or paper; observed values are '0','1','NA'.
Some analyses in the paper (e.g., association of 22q11.21 amplification with survival) are described as using time from resection, consistent with this time_var.
